$comment: Prompts for this game: paper, polished X/O marks and the emote bubble are generated with Image Gen; legacy wooden art is baked with Blender (render_assets.py). emblem (the result board's picture) was made with Antigravity (agy, its built-in image tool: Codex had no image tool on this account), asked for on flat #00FF00 and keyed out with Pillow (only the green touching the border, so green parts of the object stay).

island.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top a giant wooden tic-tac-toe board with chunky red X and blue O pieces, small bushes and a tiny red flag. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.

paper.prompt: Seamless flat top-down warm ivory natural notebook paper (#f4eedf), subtle fibers and fine matte tooth, evenly illuminated. No lines, grid, marks, pen, hand, text, shadows, folds, edges or vignette. Generated with Image Gen for the paper-and-ink Caro board.

mark-x.prompt: Exactly one capital X made from two perfectly straight, equal-width red lacquer strokes with soft rounded ends, crossing cleanly at the center. Polished, precise and balanced, with a restrained bevel and a small soft highlight from the upper left. Smooth enamel surface, uniform thickness, no hand-drawn variation. Front-facing, centered, fills about 78% of a square canvas with generous transparent padding. Deep vermilion red (#A52F3E) with a slightly darker red edge. No paper, grid, board, text, hand, brush, texture, watermark or extra objects.

mark-o.prompt: Exactly one perfectly circular, closed O ring in deep blue lacquer, with a smooth transparent inner opening and uniform ring width matching the X mark. Polished, precise and balanced, with the same front-facing angle, restrained bevel, gloss level and upper-left highlight as the matching red X. Smooth enamel surface, no hand-drawn variation. Centered, fills about 78% of a square canvas with generous transparent padding. Deep blue (#245477) with a slightly darker blue edge. No paper, grid, board, text, hand, brush, texture, watermark or extra objects.

emote-bubble.prompt: One empty, nearly square speech bubble sprite for a polished friendly board-game UI. Warm ivory fill (#FFF9EC), clean even dark warm-brown outline (#6C4935), short smooth tail attached at the lower-left and pointing toward the player's avatar. Flat fill with only a small restrained shadow outside the outline, crisp antialiased vector-like edges, sized to frame a large emoji sticker. Transparent canvas. No words, emoji, symbols, paper texture, background, glow or other objects.

emblem.prompt: A game emblem: a round award rosette made of folded cream notebook paper with faint blue ruled lines, a big hand-drawn lacquer-red X and a lacquer-blue O side by side in its middle, two ribbon tails below in red and blue, a small gold star sticker on top. Style: toy-like Vietnamese 2.5D cartoon game art, soft rounded chunky volumes like a carved wooden toy, clean flat color blocks with gentle cel shading, sunlight from the top left, short soft shadow, each outline a darker shade of its own fill (never black), no text, no letters, no numbers. Centered, the object fills about 80% of a square frame. Background: perfectly flat pure green #00FF00 everywhere around the object, no gradient, no floor, no cast shadow on the background.
